battle.name: 赫爾梅內吉爾德的起義
battle.theater: 西班牙南部（梅里達至塞維亞）
battle.brief: 公元580年，西哥特王子赫爾梅內吉爾德在梅里達起兵，拒絕交出妻子英貢德與庫藏，並得法蘭克援軍，與父王萊奧維吉爾德、弟子里卡雷德對抗九年，589年塞維亞城破時被圍殺。卡面秦弩未入此役，卻是蓄力弩的源頭：塞維亞圍城以弩炮守城，攻城方靠投石與撞槌，弩的價值正在把進攻者壓在牆外。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 公元580年爆發的這場起義，交戰的兩方是西哥特王國的王位繼承人和他的父親。叛方是西哥特王萊奧維吉爾德的長子赫爾梅內吉爾德：573年王室分封時，他取得南方的貝提卡，以羅馬帝國建城埃梅里塔（今西班牙梅里達）為治所，據有獨立的守軍、鑄幣廠與地方稅賦。叛方的外援是法蘭克王國——其妻英貢德是勃艮第的西哥特系法蘭克王貢特拉姆之女，貢特拉姆派出的法蘭克援軍自北方越過比利牛斯山南入，成為叛軍最硬的靠山；南方受壓於天主教王廷的阿里烏派與一性派教士亦多暗中支持，因此起義很快從一城之事擴為貝提卡數城的聯動。王方則是萊奧維吉爾德在位時握於一手的中樞：國王以托勒多為首都與軍資總匯，調集王師、邊區伯爵的騎兵與附庸步卒；沿托勒多經科爾多瓦通往塞維亞的河谷道路是南進的補給線，新迦太基的港口則供應海路。萊奧維吉爾德晚年把王位繼承權收向幼子里卡雷德，把長子排除在繼承序列之外，這使父子之爭從權位分配變成了王位本身。586年萊奧維吉爾德病逝於托勒多，弟子里卡雷德即位，起義隨即轉成兄弟之間長達九年的內戰。
countriesEn: The rising that broke out in 580 CE was fought between a claimant to the Visigothic throne and his father. The rebel side was Herminaegild, eldest son of the Visigothic king Leovigild: when the royal house partitioned the kingdom in 573 he had been allotted the south, Baetica, with the Roman-founded city of Emerita, modern Mérida in Spain, as his seat, and he held an independent garrison, a mint and the local revenues. His foreign support came from the Frankish kingdom: his wife Ingund was a daughter of Guntram, the Burgundian Visigothic Frankish king, and the Frankish troops sent by Guntram crossed the Pyrenees from the north and came down into the peninsula, and they were the hard core of the rebel cause. Arian and Monophysite clergy in the south, oppressed under the Catholic court, supported the rising quietly as well, and so what began as the affair of a single city soon became a rising of several towns in Baetica. On the king's side stood the central government Leovigild held in his own hands: the king made Toledo his capital and the muster point of his armies, drawing on the royal host, the cavalry of the counts on the frontier and the foot of his vassals; the road through Córdoba from Toledo to Seville along the river valleys was the line of supply for the advance south, while the harbour of New Carthage supplied the sea route. Late in his reign Leovigild drew the succession towards his younger son Reccared and put the eldest son outside the order of succession, which turned a dispute over shares of power into a dispute over the throne itself. Leovigild fell ill and died at Toledo in 586, his younger brother Reccared succeeded him, and the rising became a civil war between the two brothers that ran for nine years.
people: 這場九年內戰把西哥特王室幾乎所有人都捲了進去。赫爾梅內吉爾德是起義的靈魂：他娶法蘭克王女英貢德為妻，據梅里達起兵後拒絕交出妻子與王室寶藏，殺逐萊奧維吉爾德派去的官員，奪取城防與軍械，隨後以貝提卡各城為節點向外擴張。他的父親萊奧維吉爾德是西哥特史上最重兵的君主之一，568年即位後在伊比利亞重建王權，削弱貴族選王的舊例，晚年改宗尼西亞派並鋪平里卡雷德的繼承道路，最終在托勒多病逝。弟子里卡雷德接位後接手平叛，把戰爭重心放在封鎖與攻心，最終在塞維亞城破時逼死了赫爾梅內吉爾德。英貢德的命運最能說明這場戰爭的宗教與外交色彩：她被丈夫送到托勒多，被要求改宗而拒絕，後被放逐到法蘭克方面的圖盧茲，死後又由里卡雷德送回梅里達安葬，後來竟因她的緣故成為梅里達反對王室的由頭之一。編年史記載，塞維亞破城時赫爾梅內吉爾德死於自己人手中，是被一名親屬所殺，這一筆至今仍是史家判斷各方裂痕的關鍵。史料方面，核心是赫爾梅內吉爾德的同鄉、出身於梅里達流亡家族的約翰·比克拉羅（後任赫羅納主教），他在十世紀末寫成的《編年史》保存了起義的逐年記事；伊西多爾·塞維利亞的《哥特史》則提供了政治與宗教的骨架；教宗格里高利一世在589年派出的使團，是王廷轉向的外部標記。
peopleEn: The nine years of civil war pulled almost the whole Visigothic royal house into it. Herminaegild was the driving spirit of the rising: having married the Frankish princess Ingund, he rose at Mérida, refused to surrender either his wife or the royal treasure, killed or drove off the officials sent by Leovigild, seized the walls and the arsenal, and afterwards spread outward from town to town across Baetica. His father Leovigild was among the most military of the Visigothic monarchs: after taking the throne in 568 he rebuilt royal authority in Iberia, broke the old custom by which the great lords chose the king, and late in life converted to the Nicene faith and smoothed the path for Reccared's succession, only to die of illness at Toledo. His younger brother Reccared took over the suppression of the rising, shifted the weight of the war onto blockade and psychological pressure, and in the end brought about the death of Herminaegild when Seville fell. The fate of Ingund shows most plainly the religious and diplomatic colouring of this war: she was sent by her husband to Toledo, was required to convert and refused, was afterwards exiled to Toulouse on the Frankish side, and after her death Reccared had her brought back to Mérida for burial, and she later became one of the reasons why Mérida rose against the king's side. The chronicle records that when Seville was taken Herminaegild was killed by his own people, by one of his kinsmen, and that detail remains the key by which historians judge where the loyalties of the rebel side had cracked. As for the sources, the core of them is John of Biclaro, a native of the same town as Herminaegild, descended from the families exiled from Mérida and later bishop of Girona, whose Chronica, written at the end of the tenth century, preserves the year-by-year record of the rising; the Historia Gothorum of Isidore of Seville supplies the political and religious framework; and the mission sent by Pope Gregory the Great in 589 is the outward sign of the turn taken by the court.
kits: 卡面這把秦弩並不出現在西哥特人的營地裡，但它是理解這場戰爭裝備面貌的正確入口。秦弩是公元前二世紀末在中國北方成形的蓄力弩：木製弩機把拉力預先儲存，張弦之後不必再與弓弦較力，瞄準時手眼可穩，射速又遠勝拉弓，最後一批射出的弩矢往往壓在進攻者的頭頂。地中海有自己的一條技術線：希臘人自公元前四世紀末起使用手擲的弩，羅馬人把它擴展為軍用弩炮與弧弩，靠扭簧儲能，靠絞盤與皮筋拉弦，羅馬軍團的裝備清單裡到晚期仍列有弩炮部隊。中國的蓄力弩與地中海的弩炮是兩條獨立的技術脈絡：一邊出自春秋戰國的複合弓與扳機，另一邊出自希臘手弩與羅馬扭簧；兩者解決的是同一個問題——如何在不靠臂力的情況下把箭矢射得更遠更密。塞維亞圍城正是這個原理的實戰：城上的弩炮把進攻者壓在壕溝與牆根之外，攻城方則以投石機與撞槌配合，雙方的弩術、箭矢與配重同樣是消耗戰的關鍵。西哥特軍隊在裝備上基本沿用晚期羅馬體系：長劍、長矛與較短的標槍、小型盾與較大的曲盾、縱脊盔配鼻護、鎖子甲與鱗甲；日耳曼成分則是沉重的長矛與短刀。弓箭仍是遠射主力，短弓射程有限，弩炮則是攻守兩用器械的頂端。馬匹是西哥特社會最重要的財產與戰略資源，貴族以馬群計資產，騎兵以長矛與長劍作戰。攻城可用雲梯、撞槌、攻城塔與填土壘，封鎖則靠壕溝、鹿砦與切斷河海糧道；運輸以牛車與馬車為主，瓜達基維爾河與沿海是南方補給的動脈。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card never appeared in a Visigothic camp, but it is the right point of entry for understanding the equipment of this war. The Chinese crossbow was a stored-tension weapon that took shape in northern China at the end of the second century BC: its wooden lock and trigger held the tension in advance, so that once drawn the archer no longer had to hold the string, could aim steadily with one hand, and could fire far faster than a bow, and the last flight of bolts typically fell on the heads of the attackers. The Mediterranean had a technical line of its own: from the end of the fourth century BC the Greeks used a hand-thrown crossbow, and the Romans expanded it into the military ballista and the arcuballista, storing energy in torsion springs and drawing the cord by capstan and sinew, and the equipment lists of the Roman army still carried units of ballistae into the late period. The Chinese stored-tension crossbow and the Mediterranean ballista are two independent technical traditions: one grew out of the composite bow and the trigger of the Chinese Spring and Autumn and Warring States, the other out of the Greek cheiroballista and the Roman torsion spring; but both answer the same question, namely how to shoot further and denser without relying on the strength of the arm. The siege of Seville was the practical test of that principle: the ballistae on the walls kept the attackers outside the ditch and against the foot of the curtain, while the besiegers answered with stone-throwers and rams, and on both sides the crossbows, the bolts and the counterweights were the hinge of a war of attrition. The Visigothic army in its equipment followed the late Roman system closely: the spatha, the long spear and the shorter javelin, small shields and the large curved scutum, ridge helmets with a nasal, mail and scale. The Germanic element was the heavy framea and the seax. The bow remained the main missile weapon, though the short bow had limited range, and the ballista stood at the top of the range of weapons that served both in attack and in defence. Horses were the most important property and strategic resource of Visigothic society, the aristocracy counted its wealth in herds, and the cavalry fought with spear and spatha. A siege could use ladders, rams, siege towers and an agger, while a blockade relied on ditches, palisades and the cutting of the river and sea grain routes; transport was by ox cart and wagon, and the Guadalquivir and the coast were the arteries of supply in the south.
tactics: 叛方的打法是以城為堡。赫爾梅內吉爾德沒有與王師正面決戰的打算：他以梅里達為核心，聯結貝提卡與瓜達基維爾河谷的城市，靠城牆、弩炮與地方武裝抵擋王軍，靠法蘭克方向的輸入維持糧食與兵員，把戰爭拖成九年之久的圍城與游擊的混合體。同時，他向南方受壓的阿里烏派教士與貴族伸手，把起義說成是對天主教王權的抵抗，這讓叛軍在宗教上有了號召，但也讓它在589年之後失去了退路，因為對手同樣可以用宗教語言回擊。王方的戰術則是分割加封鎖。萊奧維吉爾德以托勒多為基地，集結王師與伯爵邊軍，靠騎兵的快速打擊切斷叛軍彼此的聯繫，而不是急於攻取每一座城；梅里達守軍在582年另行起事時，他派出的鎮壓部隊採取的是突擊加隔離，而非長圍。里卡雷德即位後把重心移到塞維亞：589年的大軍把全城圍住，歷時數月，封鎖河道與海上出入，同時以招降、離間和收買赫爾梅內吉爾德親屬的方式削弱守方。攻城方向上，填土壘把壕溝一段段填平，撞槌與投石機消耗城頭，弩炮則在兩側遠程對射，決定傷亡節奏的正是弩與配重的供應。城破之後，赫爾梅內吉爾德在混亂中死於自己人之手。
tacticsEn: The method of the rebels was to make the walled town their fortress. Herminaegild had no intention of meeting the royal host in open battle: he took Mérida as his core, linked the towns of Baetica and of the Guadalquivir valley, held off the royal armies with walls, ballistae and local levies, and kept his grain and his men coming in from the Frankish side, turning the war into a mixture of siege and harassment that lasted nine years. At the same time he reached out to the Arian clergy and the lords of the south who were under pressure, presenting the rising as a resistance to a Catholic court; that gave the rebel army a religious appeal, but it also left it without a way back after 589, since the other side could answer in the same religious language. The tactics of the king's side were division and blockade. Leovigild used Toledo as his base, gathered the royal host and the border troops of the counts, and cut the rebel cities off from one another by fast strikes of cavalry rather than hurrying to take every town one by one; when the garrison of Mérida rose separately in 582, the force he sent took the town by surprise and by isolation rather than by a long investment. Once Reccared was on the throne the centre of gravity moved to Seville: in 589 the great army surrounded the whole city for a period of months, closed the river mouth and the sea approaches, and at the same time wore the defenders down by offers of pardon, by sowing dissension and by buying over kinsmen of Herminaegild. On the side of the attack, the agger filled the ditch section by section, rams and stone-throwers wore down the defenders on the walls, and ballistae answered one another in long-range duel from the two flanks, so that the supply of crossbows and counterweights set the pace of the losses. After the city fell, Herminaegild was killed by his own people in the confusion.
data: 可核對的數字不多，而且多數是繫年而非計數。起義的年份一般繫於公元580年，終於589年，前後約九年；比克拉羅《編年史》逐年記下580年起事、586年萊奧維吉爾德卒於托勒多與里卡雷德即位，以及589年塞維亞被圍、赫爾梅內吉爾德之死。573年萊奧維吉爾德分封王國、586年遺囑再分，是理解繼承爭議的兩個時間點。教會方面，589年5月召開的托勒多第三次會議，出席的主教約十位，會上確立尼西亞派並譴責一性派；里卡雷德受洗加冕通常記於次年1月，年份在各家抄本略有出入。圍城歷時，編年史只說「多日」，沒有給出確數，後來的推說多落在數月之間，不宜當作定論。兵力方面，法蘭克援軍在編年史中以萬計，具體數目在抄本間出入甚大，只能當作量級上的說明；叛軍與王師的實際交戰人數同樣無從核實。城市人口只有考古可以旁證：梅里達在羅馬時代是 Lusitania 的首要城市，人口曾以萬計，五世紀末衰落到一萬上下；塞維亞是西哥特在南方的主要港口，港口、城牆與城郭的規模在考古層中依稀可辨。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few, and most of them are dates rather than counts. The rising is generally dated from 580 CE and ended in 589, some nine years in all. The Chronica of John of Biclaro records year by year the rising of 580, the death of Leovigild at Toledo and the accession of Reccared in 586, and in 589 the investment of Seville and the death of Herminaegild. The partition of the kingdom by Leovigild in 573 and the further partition by his will in 586 are the two reference points for the dispute over succession. On the church side, the Third Council of Toledo, held in May 589, was attended by about ten bishops and established the Nicene faith while condemning Monophysitism; the conversion and coronation of Reccared are usually placed in the following January, though the year differs a little between copies. As to the length of the siege, the chronicle says only that it lasted many days and gives no exact figure; the later reconstructions mostly fall somewhere between several weeks and several months, and should not be treated as settled. On numbers of troops, the Frankish auxiliaries are given in the chronicle in thousands and tens of thousands, but the exact figures differ widely between manuscripts and can only be taken as an order of magnitude; the actual numbers engaged on either side cannot be verified at all. Population figures for the cities can only be approached through archaeology: Mérida was the leading city of Roman Lusitania, its population once ran into the tens of thousands, and by the end of the fifth century it had fallen to something in the region of ten thousand; Seville was the chief southern port of the Visigoths, and the scale of its harbour, walls and circuit can still be made out in the archaeological layers.
cause: 打起來的直接導火線是一樁家事。580年，萊奧維吉爾德要求長子把英貢德送回托勒多，交出王室庫藏，並命令梅里達的守軍聽命於王廷；赫爾梅內吉爾德兩樣都拒絕，隨即反戈。背後有四層更長的因果。第一層是分封留下的結構：573年王國分給三子，長子合法地握著南方的貝提卡與羅馬城梅里達，有自己的軍隊與稅源，這份權力一旦被承認，就難以收回。第二層是繼承次序：萊奧維吉爾德晚年把王位繼承權指定給幼子里卡雷德，長子與其支持者被推到只能靠叛變爭取位置的地步。第三層是婚姻與外交：英貢德是法蘭克王貢特拉姆之女，把一樁王室婚姻變成了西哥特王廷與法蘭克王國之間的角力；她被要求在托勒多改宗的消息，更把王廷的教派立場與貝提卡貴族的舊信仰捆在一起。第四層是宗教：萊奧維吉爾德推行的天主教化在南方遇到阿里烏派與一性派的抵抗，赫爾梅內吉爾德在貝提卡得到教士與部分城市的支持，起義因此帶上守護舊信仰的色彩，也就更容易在教派定案之後失去號召的基礎。
causeEn: The direct trigger of the war was a matter of family. In 580 Leovigild required his elder son to send Ingund back to Toledo, to hand over the royal treasure, and to order the garrison of Mérida to obey the court; Herminaegild refused both demands and at once turned his weapons. Behind it lay four longer causes. The first was the structure left by the partition: when the kingdom was divided among three sons in 573, the eldest lawfully held the south in Baetica together with the Roman city of Mérida, with his own troops and his own tax revenues, and such power, once conceded, was not easily taken back. The second was the order of succession: late in his reign Leovigild fixed the succession on his younger son Reccared, and the eldest son and those who stood with him were driven to the position where they could only win a place by revolt. The third was marriage and diplomacy: Ingund was a daughter of the Frankish king Guntram, and what had begun as a marriage of the royal house became a trial of strength between the Visigothic court and the Frankish kingdom; and the demand that she convert at Toledo bound the religious position of the court together with the old faith of the Baetican nobility. The fourth was religion: the Catholicisation pushed by Leovigild met Arian and Monophysite resistance in the south, and Herminaegild gained the support of clergy and of some of the towns of Baetica, so that the rising acquired the character of a defence of the old faith and, for that very reason, was the easier to strip of its appeal once the church question had been settled.
impact: 九年內戰結束之後，西哥特王國的面貌改變了。第一，起義把南方城市與王室的裂痕徹底撕開，也讓王廷明白貝提卡不是可以靠一次鎮壓解決的邊陲；戰後對塞維亞的懲處、居民被流放，以及梅里達等城的降格，說明平叛的代價由南方城市承擔。第二，宗教格局由此定案：里卡雷德在589年召開托勒多第三次會議，把尼西亞派確立為王國唯一的正統，一性派的主教被逐，阿里烏派的機構隨之崩解；格里高利一世589年的使團抵達並受到歡迎，教宗與西哥特王室的關係由此正常化，約590年里卡雷德受洗加冕，王國進入西哥特天主教政權的全盛期。第三，赫爾梅內吉爾德的形象在兩套敘事裡完全相反：伊西多爾與比克拉羅記載他在死前受洗，後世天主教會因此尊他為殉道者，塞維亞為他立教堂、塑像，十九世紀更有聖徒傳記與兄弟會把他塑造成反抗暴政的聖人；而在哥特史的框架裡，他是分裂王國的叛首。同一個人被同時寫成英雄與叛徒，這場內戰因此也成了西班牙宗教記憶裡最長久的裂口之一。第四，王國的外部位置隨之改變：589年里卡雷德與法蘭克王希爾德貝特二世聯軍討伐拜占庭在卡特奇納一帶的殘餘據點，鞏固了東南海岸的安全，此後直到711年，塞維亞與梅里達一帶是王國南方最穩定的核心區。
impactEn: When the nine years of civil war were over, the face of the Visigothic kingdom had changed. First, the rising tore open the rift between the southern cities and the court, and it taught the government that Baetica was not a frontier that could be settled by a single stroke of repression; the punishments exacted after the war, the exile of the inhabitants of Seville and the demotion of towns such as Mérida show that the cost of the pacification was borne by the southern cities. Second, the religious map was settled: Reccared convened the Third Council of Toledo in 589, established the Nicene faith as the only orthodoxy of the kingdom, expelled the Monophysite bishops and saw the Arian structure collapse with them; the mission of Gregory the Great arrived in 589 and was received gladly, normalising the relations between the papacy and the Visigothic court; and in about 590 Reccared was converted and crowned, and the kingdom entered the full height of Visigothic Catholic rule. Third, the figure of Herminaegild is exactly reversed between two traditions: Isidore and Biclaro record that he was converted before his death, and the later Catholic church accordingly venerates him as a martyr, erecting a church and a statue for him at Seville, and in the nineteenth century hagiography and brotherhoods made him a saint who had stood against tyranny; while in the framework of the Gothic history he is the rebel who had split the kingdom. The same man written at once as hero and as rebel, and the civil war became one of the most enduring fissures in the religious memory of Spain. Fourth, the external position of the kingdom changed with it: in 589 Reccared and the Frankish king Childebert II campaigned together against the last Byzantine strongholds around Cartagena, and the security of the south-eastern coast was secured; and from then until 711 the district of Seville and Mérida remained the most stable core of the kingdom in the south.
result: 589年，塞維亞在長達數月的圍困之後陷落，赫爾梅內吉爾德在城破的混亂中死於自己一方之手，據編年史是被一名親屬所殺；他留下的幼子英吉爾德在史書中只出現片刻，隨即退出記錄。貝提卡的聯盟城市隨之瓦解，王師重新控制梅里達、科爾多瓦與塞維亞，里卡雷德完成對王國的重新統一，次年受洗，並在托勒多第三次會議的框架內把尼西亞派定為國教，南方異端勢力被清除，王國進入延續到七世紀的鼎盛期。就兵器與戰術而言，這場戰爭留下兩個耐人尋味的註腳。其一，弩這類蓄力器械在實戰中的價值被反覆證明：塞維亞的攻防就是靠城頭弩炮把進攻者壓在牆外，攻城方則靠弩炮、投石與撞槌去啃城牆，而秦弩正是這條技術譜系最早成形的一支，說明蓄力、單手瞄準與密集射擊的構想並非某一地區的孤例。其二，圍城戰的勝負往往不由攻城技巧決定，而由補給與政治決定：叛軍控制的城市雖有城牆與弩炮，卻長期得不到北方法蘭克方面的實力接應，萊奧維吉爾德與里卡雷德則以托勒多為基地，以封鎖與離間配合正面施壓，於是九年的消耗終於壓垮了聯盟，誰能守住糧道，誰就守住了王位。
resultEn: In 589 Seville fell after an investment that had lasted months, and Herminaegild died in the confusion of the breach at the hands of his own side, by one of his kinsmen according to the chronicle; the young son he left behind, Ingild, appears in the record for a moment only and then vanishes from it. The allied cities of Baetica fell apart with him, the royal armies retook Mérida, Córdoba and Seville, and Reccared completed the reunification of the kingdom. In the following year he was converted, and within the framework of the Third Council of Toledo the Nicene faith was fixed as the religion of the realm, the heterodox power in the south was broken, and the kingdom entered the height of its prosperity that ran on into the seventh century. As to arms and tactics, the war left two remarks worth making. First, the value of stored-tension engines in the field was demonstrated again and again: the defence of Seville rested on the ballistae on the walls holding the attackers outside, and the besiegers in turn worked at the curtain with ballistae, stone and ram; and the Chinese crossbow is the earliest formed member of that technical family, which shows that the idea of storing the draw, aiming with one hand and shooting in dense volleys was not the peculiar invention of one region. Second, sieges are usually decided less by the skill of the assault than by supply and by politics: the rebel cities had walls and ballistae, but for years they could not count on real support reaching them from the Franks to the north, while Leovigild and Reccared worked from Toledo and paired the blockade and the sowing of dissension with pressure in the field, so that nine years of consumption finally crushed the alliance, and whoever kept the grain road kept the throne.
